title: Interactive widgets will make you lose your important reminders.
body: First, where is the opinion I wrote 2 years ago? About 2 years ago, the Reminders update completely destroyed my system. Now widgets are interactive, and it’s very easy to accidentally click a reminder and “delete” it from the list. You can’t change it. So many updates have been released, but nothing has been done about this. On the internet, so many people complain about it, and they don’t care. Because of this “super feature,” you can delete your reminder without even realizing it. :)

title: Issue with recurring reminders
body: I really like this app right now! There is a lot of features, but not too much 👍 But I have one issue with recurring reminders. Let me give you my real example - I have reminder for cleaning at each Sunday and I have 6 subtasks there. It seems that is constantly the same reminder, which means that e.g when I mark 2 subtasks as done today, they will be also marked at next Sunday and so on. It would be nice to have fresh and not checked list at each Sunday, because this, that I did laundry past week doesn't mean I don't have to do it again in this week etc. 😄

This problem ruins the whole experience in this otherwise great app.

title: Good for basic tasks, awful for anything else.
body:
I’ll skip here syncing issues (it happens mainly on web, but sometimes I got it on my phone) and point out the most basic issues:
- there’s no start date feature
- tapping on background to trigger new task action? Who did think it would be even remotely good idea?
- bigger check buttons would be great, it’s hard sometimes to tap it
- filters are way too basic. I can’t select even lists which I would like to see.
- there’s no setting to hide tasks. I have some tasks dated on 1 year ahead and I have to see that every time I visit a list? Terrible experience.

In summary Reminders lacks way too many features to become a real tasks app. macOS version is even worse.
